sentence: This project studies how parasites and their hosts compete for resources inside the host, using a method that measures many elements at once.
This project builds polymeric nanomaterials and studies how they switch on the inflammasome, a multiprotein complex, in immune cells.
This project tests a way to convert microwave signals into optical signals using acoustic waveguides, for use in quantum computers.
This project covers statistical methods used to analyze genetic and genomic data, including quantitative genetics.
This project develops ways to protect energy systems, such as the electric grid, from attacks and failures in their cyber infrastructure.
This project builds digital models of fungal cells to predict which genetic edits help them make and release more protein.
This project uses speckle imaging to look for companion stars around nearby stars and to find out how unusual the Sun is.
This project builds a compact terahertz source that works at room temperature, using a ferrimagnet driven by an electric current.
This project develops tools to study RNA inside living cells, showing where it is and what it interacts with, without breaking cells apart.
This project explores how insect farming can turn waste into useful products and support food and feed production.
This project studies how corals get their algal partners back after ocean temperatures rise, using live imaging in a small sea anemone.
This project develops methods and tools to reduce technical debt in machine learning systems so they stay reliable over time.
This project builds artificial intelligence tools to work out how genes regulate each other, using large sets of omics data.
This project studies how a driving centromere gains unfair copies in the yellow monkeyflower and how some plants resist it.
This project develops control methods that keep autonomous systems safe and reliable when conditions change and are uncertain.
This project builds a large computing facility that will run a system called Horizon for simulations, data analytics and artificial intelligence research.
